name: Gaussian Mixture Models
learningObjectives: Understand probabilistic clustering with Gaussian distributions
Master soft vs hard clustering assignments
Discover how GMM handles overlapping clusters
Understand model selection with AIC and BIC
Learn about covariance types and their impact

controls.label: Number of Components (k)
controls.tooltip: Number of Gaussian components in the mixture model.

controls.label: Covariance Type
controls.tooltip: Type of covariance matrix for each component.

visualizations.title: Gaussian Mixture Model
visualizations.description: Scatter plot showing data points colored by most likely component assignment with component centers

visualizations.title: Log-Likelihood Over Iterations
visualizations.description: Line chart showing how log-likelihood increases during EM algorithm iterations

metrics.name: Log-Likelihood
metrics.description: Log-likelihood of the data given the model (higher is better)

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: AIC
metrics.description: Akaike Information Criterion for model selection (lower is better)

metrics.name: BIC
metrics.description: Bayesian Information Criterion for model selection (lower is better)

metrics.name: Iterations
metrics.description: Number of EM iterations until convergence

metrics.name: Converged
metrics.description: Whether the algorithm converged before reaching maximum iterations
